Výsledek kontroly: Magie je uzavřena pro: Review result: Magic is finalised for the basic version. MATK/MDEF formulas, coefficients, schools, the INT scale, Min. Levels, knowledge and starting spells, area and influence effects, bosses, healing, concentration, defensive bonuses and the equipment interface each have one final rule. The catalogue contains 110 spells and no provisional mechanics.
Nejjednodušší praktická kouzla: světlo,: The simplest practical spells: light, minor manipulation, finding things, repairs and basic protection. This is not an elemental school.
Fire, heat, burning, smoke and explosions. Strong in direct attacks and creating obstacles.
Voda, led a chlad. Kombinuje útok, zpoma: Water, ice and cold. Combines attacks, slowing effects, protection and movement in aquatic environments.
Vítr, blesky, bouře, levitace, let a tel: Wind, lightning, storms, levitation, flight and teleportation. Teleportation belongs here, rather than to Star Magic.
Půda, kámen, minerály, pevnost a fyzická: Soil, stone, minerals, solidity and physical protection. Excels at defence and changing terrain.
Telekineze, telepatie, myšlenky, emoce,: Telekinesis, telepathy, thoughts, emotions, illusions and mental influence. Telekinesis belongs here.
Duše, duchové, životní síla, požehnání,: Souls, spirits, life force, blessings, soul protection and communication with spirits.
Léčení, očista, ochrana a světelné útoky: Healing, cleansing, protection and light attacks. Healing spells use the Healing coefficient.
Strach, kletby, stíny, vysávání životní: Fear, curses, shadows, draining life force, weakening and necromancy. It is not automatically evil in itself.
Rostliny, zvířata, přírodní síly a příro: Plants, animals, natural forces and natural healing. Thematically close to Rangers, Elves and some Healers.
Mistrovská nadstavba pracující s osudem,: An advanced mastery school working with fate, time, reality and distant worlds. Starting characters cannot use it.
Výsledek kontroly: Globální počáteční ro: Review result: The overall starting range is INT 4–10. Wizards start at INT 7–10, Healers at INT 6–9 and other classes at INT 4–7. The latest approved levelling grants +1 to one chosen attribute for each new Level and sets a natural maximum of 20, making all INT bands attainable.
Návaznost na levelování: Hratelné jsou L: Levelling connection: Playable Levels are 1–99; on reaching Level 100, the hero retires to the Star Hall of Fame. In simple mode without XP or Levels, at most one attribute can increase by +1 after a significant adventure. A short episode is insufficient.
Obecné triky; všechna magická povolání,: General tricks; all magical classes and some other characters. An Orc outside the Wizard/Healer classes starts below the threshold.
Všichni kouzelníci; většina léčitelů; ta: All Wizards, most Healers, and Elven Warriors, Rangers, Rogues and Bards. Other characters can reach this band through development.
Elfí léčitel začíná na CH 9 a elfí kouze: An Elven Healer starts at INT 9 and an Elven Wizard at INT 10; other characters can reach this band through growth.
Dosažitelná levelováním. Elfí kouzelník: Attainable through levelling. An Elven Wizard starting at INT 10 can reach INT 11 no earlier than Level 2.
Dosažitelná levelováním do maxima 20. El: Attainable through levelling to the maximum of 20. An Elven Wizard can reach INT 14 no earlier than Level 5 if all level-up points up to then go into Intelligence; Star Magic additionally requires Min. Level 12+.
Nejvýše 3 platné cíle, pokud řádek neurč: At most 3 valid targets, unless the entry specifies fewer. Make one MATK roll; compare the same MAGICAL ATTACK separately with each target's defence. Resolve damage and secondary effects independently.
Ovlivnění používá MAGICKÝ ÚTOK proti MAG: Influence uses MAGICAL ATTACK against MAGICAL DEFENCE. Only a higher attack succeeds; on an equal or lower result, the target resists.
Boss neztratí celý tah, neusne, nezmění: A boss does not lose an entire turn, fall asleep, change sides, automatically flee or become fully incapacitated. Apply the weakened effect in the spell's entry; if absent, until the end of its next turn, apply −2 to its first PATK, MATK or check and prevent special abilities in that action.
Výsledek = zaokr(základ × koeficient Léč: Result = round(base × Healing coefficient) + item bonuses; round to the nearest whole number, with exactly 0.5 rounded up. A caster uses at most 1 healing spell per battle.
Nejvýše 1 aktivní kouzlo se soustředěním: At most 1 active concentration spell. Casting another spell ends it before the new spell is resolved. Movement, physical actions and damage do not end it by themselves; the spell's entry may specify another condition.
X se násobí koeficientem Magie povolání: Multiply X by the class Magic coefficient and round 0.5 up; it then contributes to MATK.
Pevný obranný účinek kouzla; koeficient: A fixed defensive spell effect; the Magic coefficient does not apply. Add the highest currently active spell bonus for PDEF and the highest for MDEF to the sum of item bonuses. Multiple spell bonuses to the same defence do not stack.
X se násobí koeficientem Léčení a zaokro: Multiply X by the Healing coefficient and round to the nearest whole number, with exactly 0.5 rounded up. Then add applicable item healing bonuses.
